L20: # DEPARTMENTS
L21: 
L22:   1. cite7†9th Annual Winchendon Fall Festival L23: 
L24: Mark your calendars! Fallfest 2025 will be held on October 11, 2025, from 10 am to 5 pm in downtown Winchendon.
L25: 
L26:   2. cite8†Accounting Office L27: 
L28: The Town Accountant's Office provides professional staff expertise for financial planning, accounting, and budgeting.
L29: 
L30:   3. cite9†Animal Control L31: 
L32: We are pleased to announce that our shelter is now located at 381 Baldwinville Road Templeton, the previous home of Ahimsa Haven.
L33: 
L34:   4. cite10†Assessor's Office L35: Find information about the Board of Assessors' Office.
L36: 
L37:   5. cite11†Board of Health L38: 
L39: Winchendon has a five-member Board of Health whose members work along with a Health Agent and Health Inspector.
L40: 
L41:   6. cite12†Building Department L42: 
L43: The Building Department issues permits and schedules inspections for all building, plumbing, gas fitting, and wiring projects in the Town of Winchendon. The Building Department also upholds and enforces the Town’s zoning by-laws.
L44: 
L45:   7. cite13†Collector / Treasurer L46: The Collector's Office is responsible for the efficient and timely billing and collection of all monies due the Town including real estate tax, excise motor vehicle tax, personal property tax, and water bill payments.
L47: 
L48:   8. cite14†Emergency Management L49: 
L50: Find information related to emergency management.
L51: 
L52:   9. cite15†Fire / EMS L53: 
L54: Our mission is to protect life and property through emergency response and non-emergency assistance, and to promote public safety through inspection, enforcement, and education.
L55:   10. cite16†Beals Memorial Library L56: 
L57: The Beals Memorial Library provides a free and open environment where all may gather for education, culture and information.
L58: 
L59:   11. cite17†Parks & Recreation L60: 
L61: Our mission is to enhance the quality of life in our community through vibrant parks and engaging recreational programs.
L62: 
L63:   12. cite18†Planning & Development L64: 
L65: The Department of Planning and Development serves as the town’s chief planning and development office.
L66: 
L67:   13. cite19†Police Department L68: The mission of the Town of Winchendon Police Department is to deliver professional, courteous and unbiased police services to all citizens and visitors of the town.
L69: 
L70:   14. cite20†Public Works L71: 
L72: The Public Works Department is made up of several divisions including highway, water/sewer, fleet maintenance, cemeteries and parks, solid waste transfer station, and the wastewater treatment plant.
L73: 
L74:   15. cite21†Re-Broadcast of Public Meetings & Events L75: 
L76: Tune in to Winchendon Channel 8 to view at listed times.
L77:   16. cite22†Registrar of Voters L78: 
L79: Find information about the Registrar of Voters.
L80: 
L81:   17. cite23†School Department†www.winchendonk12.org L82: 
L83: Welcome to Winchendon Public Schools!
L84: 
L85:   18. cite24†Winchendon Senior Center L86: 
L87: The mission of the Winchendon Council on Aging is to provide our seniors with educational programs, recreational activities, and social services assistance, and to advocate for our seniors while educating the community.
L88: 
L89:   19. cite25†Town Clerk L90: The Town Clerk is responsible for recording and certifying all official actions of the Town, and oversees all aspects of voting and elections. Additional responsibilities include posting meetings and issuing licenses.
L91: 
L92:   20. cite26†Town Manager L93: 
L94: The Town of Winchendon is pleased to welcome Bill McKinney as the new Town Manager.
L95: 
L96:   21. cite27†Transfer Station L97: 
L98: The Town of Winchendon operates a transfer station that is open to all town residents for their disposal of household waste and recyclables.
L99:   22. cite28†Transportation L100: 
L101: Volunteer at the Winchendon Senior Center The Winchendon Senior Center relies on volunteers to help support programs, meals, events, and services that enrich the lives of older adults in our community. Whether you have a few hours a month or can volunteer on a regular basis, your time and talents help create a welcoming, connected, and supportive environment for local seniors. Learn more about volunteer opportunities and how to get involved.
L102: 
L103:   23. cite29†Veterans' Services L104: The mission of Veterans' Services for the Town of Winchendon is to assist each veteran and their dependents through state and federal benefits.
L105: 
L106:   24. cite30†Winchendon Housing Authority L107: 
L108: The Housing Authority shall make studies of the housing needs of the community and shall provide programs to make available housing for families of low income and for elderly person of low income.
L109:
